## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Platform Constitution Compliance

Please confirm that your feature request aligns with the Platform Constitution:

- [ ] **Free First** — Free solution before paid alternative
- [ ] **Open Source First** — Open source before proprietary
- [ ] **Self-Hosted First** — Self-hosted before SaaS
- [ ] **No Vendor Lock-In** — Every component replaceable
- [ ] **Reuse Before Build** — Check existing features first

## Use Case

Describe the target users and how this feature would benefit them.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here.
